refresh_note: Each provider has a 'refresh' block. strategy='manual' means prices must be verified by a human against the provider's pricing_url. strategy='json_api' adds 'url' and 'map' ({tier:{field:[json path]}}) for programmatic drift checks via refresh.check_drift(). The refresh path proposes changes for review; it never writes prices.json or advances verified_at automatically. SC2: providers with an 'openrouter' strategy are drift-checked against the OpenRouter /api/v1/models feed (per-token prices x1e6 to per-1M). Groq stays manual (OpenRouter prices the open model, not Groq's specific hosting, so a comparison would be apples-to-oranges). Qwen stays manual (unstable OpenRouter ids for the current Qwen3.x lineup).
